rewrites.comment: SPA history fallback. React Router owns /segments, /customers/:id and friends; without this a hard refresh on a deep link returns Vercel's 404 because no such file exists in dist/.

headers.comment: Vite emits content-hashed asset filenames, so a given URL's bytes never change - cache them for a year and skip revalidation.
Baseline hardening. No CSP here: it would need to enumerate the API origin, which differs per deployment, and a wrong CSP silently breaks every chart.
